Class RMIClientHandler

java.lang.Object
java.rmi.server.RemoteObject
java.rmi.server.RemoteServer
java.rmi.server.UnicastRemoteObject
it.polimi.ingsw.am54.network.server.RMIClientHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
RMIClientHandlerInterface, ClientConnection, Serializable, Remote
public class RMIClientHandler extends UnicastRemoteObject implements RMIClientHandlerInterface, ClientConnection
============================================================================ RMIClientHandler — Handler for an RMI connection for a client ============================================================================ ROLE: - Handles RMI requests from a client - Forwards requests to the Controller (single game) - Implements ClientConnection (sendUpdate via RMI callback) - Manages heartbeat (ping/pong) ============================================================================
